welcome.title: What do you want to secure today?
welcome.subtitle: Fenix answers with Red Team judgement about your systems, your code and your own rules. The documents you upload to the knowledge base are its context.

api.title: API authorization
api.description: Checks whether every endpoint cares who is calling, not just whether the caller is authenticated.
api.prompt: Analyse the authorization of my API: look for endpoints where an IDOR or a horizontal privilege escalation lets one user read another user's data.

oauth.title: OAuth flows
oauth.description: Reviews the redirect_uri, state, PKCE and the scopes that get granted when they do not need to be.
oauth.prompt: Review my OAuth 2.0 flows: check the redirect_uri validation, the use of the state parameter, whether PKCE is implemented properly, and whether the granted scopes are the minimum.

ssrf.title: SSRF vectors
ssrf.description: Finds user-supplied input that ends up in an outgoing request the user controls.
ssrf.prompt: Detect SSRF vectors in my code: find where a URL or a host controlled by the user ends up in an outgoing request, and which filters it bypasses.

logica.title: Business logic
logica.description: The flows that work as expected, where the order of the operations is what opens the door.
logica.prompt: Audit the business logic of my application: look for flows where changing the order of operations, repeating a request or skipping a step allows achieving something that should not be possible.
